run_batch_export_scannet: run the batch export script to process all Scannet training scans into detection data
run_export_one_scan: run export_one_scan to convert a single Scannet scan into vertices and label numpy files
create_scannet_detection_data: create numpy files for mesh vertices, semantic labels, instance labels, and bounding boxes from a Scannet scan
filter_scannet_instances: filter Scannet scan instances to keep only OBJ_CLASS_IDS and discard DONOTCARE_CLASS_IDS
downsample_scannet_vertices: downsample mesh vertices to MAX_NUM_POINT when a scan exceeds 50000 points
